items.review_rationale: Reviewed left vector space over possibly noncommutative division ring with abelian addition and left scalar action, both distributivities, product association and unitality.

references.phrase: scalar action D times V to V

references.context: Left scalar action distributes over vector addition.
Left action is additive in the division-ring scalar argument.
Order of division ring product is preserved on the left.
Division ring multiplicative identity fixes each vector.

references.disposition: This is a left module-style vector space over division ring, not automatically a right vector space.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed normed division ring as ordered pair of associative division ring D and specified exact-multiplicative real-valued norm satisfying positive definiteness and triangle inequality.

references.phrase: scalar norm not a vector norm
references.disposition: The specified multiplicative norm belongs to underlying division ring; no vector space is required.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed right vector space over noncommutative division ring with abelian vector addition, right scalar action and correct product order (va)b=v(ab), plus unitality.

references.phrase: right scalar action V times D to V

references.context: Right scalar multiplication distributes over vector addition.
Order of multiplication of division-ring scalars matches successive right actions.
Specified multiplicative identity fixes vectors on the right.

references.disposition: For noncommutative division ring one cannot silently identify right and left scalar actions.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed natural-number convention N={0,1,2,...} with explicitly distinguished positive subset consisting exactly of nonzero natural numbers.

references.context: Discrete progression of successive nonnegative whole-number values starting at zero.
Natural numbers strictly greater than zero, namely N excluding zero.

references.disposition: This source's natural-number collection includes zero, unlike an alternative positive-start counting convention.
